title: CREMA — exact original procedural texture snapshots
generator: scripts/export-models.mjs; lossless PNG writer using Node built-in zlib
provenance: Original code-generated seeded cellular pores and multiscale noise. No AI image, research figure or external texture is used in these two maps.

runtimeProjection.weights: abs(normalize(object-local vertex normal)) raised to power 8, divided by the sum
runtimeProjection.planes: Sample YZ, ZX and XY, weighted by X, Y and Z respectively
runtimeProjection.height: 88% pow(linear-RGB luminance of blended colour, 0.60) + 12% procedural height sampled at p * 2.60
runtimeProjection.cellularField: clamp(height * 1.60 - 0.10, 0, 1), shared by roughness, coating and cavity shading
runtimeProjection.relief: Height derivatives scaled by bumpScale * instance scale * group scale perturb the view-space normal
runtimeProjection.textureTransforms: RepeatWrapping applies; Texture.repeat, offset, rotation and ordinary geometry UVs are not used by this custom projection
runtimeProjection.portability: Plain UV-mapped PBR and the texture-free GLBs do not reproduce the runtime shader by themselves

files.pixelFormat: RGBA8, lossless; source bytes and row order preserved

runtime.sampling: Linear magnification, linear mipmap minification; generate mipmaps
runtime.projection: The runtime custom shader uses object-space triplanar mapping; ordinary UV texture transforms are ignored.
